title: Make an LLM Call Tools Reliably
core_invariant: A tool interface is a schema plus an execution boundary, not a prompt suggestion. Model-proposed calls are untrusted input and must be validated before side effects. Parseable JSON is not sufficient reliability. Schema failure is distinct from tool failure. Side-effecting tools require approval and an idempotency key; replay applies the effect at most once. Retries are bounded. Predict before every tool action. Transfer without assistance. Generic WP-137 metric and table blocks carry the evidence; there is no custom frontend.

stages.title: Frame the V10 tool-execution trust boundary
stages.instructions: Restate the M32 inference-provider / InferenceConfig discipline: training_time=False, weights_updated=False, fail-closed live adapter. M37 starts V10 with a validated tool registry (runtime_version v10-teaching-tools-1, registry_id v10-teaching-registry-1, seed 3701, max_attempts 3). Identify gate evidence: fail-closed schema cases, tool selection including no-tool, structured success/error, idempotent side effects, bounded retry, a no-AI tool-contract, and a V10 tool-execution ADR. Do not import LangGraph or Anthropic SDKs, open RAG/Qdrant, or build a state machine. No custom frontend.

stages.title: Read parse, validate, permission, idempotency, execute
stages.instructions: Read parse, validate, permission, idempotency, execute, and result without running a live model. Predict that invalid calls never reach execute_tool, that schema versus tool error types are distinct, and that a same-key replay does not increment the ledger. Submit an annotated call-trace. Live adapters fail closed.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Trace names the live contract and a rejected or illegal path.

stages.title: Predict, then validate and execute tool calls
stages.instructions: Complete the experiment cycle on the generic runtime. (1) PREDICT valid VAT/catalog calls execute once, missing-field/wrong-type/extra-field/unsafe proposals never increment the execution counter, and a same-key replay is idempotent. (2) COMMIT. (3) EXECUTE / RUN the teaching registry on fixture proposals; emit WP-137 table of proposal/status/execution_reached and a metric of schema_valid, effect_count, idempotent_replay. (4) OBSERVE. (5) SUBMIT / EXPLAIN. Do not coerce invalid JSON. Do not call a paid API.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Prediction is sealed before execute; submitted explanation covers the observed WP-137 blocks. No universal accuracy threshold.

stages.title: Diagnose malformed arguments and duplicate posts
stages.instructions: Named faults, one change each. Fault A: malformed arguments reach a side-effecting tool because validation is skipped. Predict effect_count increments; repair restores validation so effect_count stays 0 on the repaired path while the original object still posted. Fault B: a timeout-retry posts twice without an idempotency key. Repair keys the post; original object still shows two posts. Swapping models is not the first lever. Emit a WP-137 table of broken versus repaired effect_count.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Each failure names one controlled cause; the repair restores the named contract from the broken object.

stages.title: Defend a tool contract without assistance
stages.instructions: From a blank page, without inventing an SDK, do duty arithmetic, four-way classification (valid, schema, tool, no-tool), an idempotency count, error locus, and why JSON is not enough. Tutor surfaces stay locked. Emit a WP-137 artifact. Leave responses unfilled.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: Independent no-AI reasoning names the contract, a valid repair, and does not invent deferred machinery.

stages.title: Choose a V10 tool-execution policy
stages.instructions: Complete an ADR for the V10 tool-execution trust boundary: schema strictness, permissions, idempotency, retry limits, and trace fields. Reject parseable-JSON-as-sufficient and unbounded retry. Do not implement a state machine here.

validation_rubric.pass_criteria: ADR names a decision, rejected alternative, owner, status, and date.

stages.title: Start V10 from a validated registry
stages.instructions: Start V10 from a validated registry/executor and structured call/result/error traces. M38 may add a state machine only after invalid calls never reach execution.

stages.title: Evaluate tool-calling evidence
stages.instructions: Evaluate orientation, tool-validation experiment, malformed/duplicate diagnosis, and unassisted transfer. Issue PASSED or a targeted repair plan. Do not award completion from a successful happy-path only.
